# Morgan International Community School (MICS)

> A premier international school in Ghana offering Cambridge and IB curricula with strong academic programs, STEM initiatives, and comprehensive student support services.

MICS is an international community school in Ghana that combines Cambridge International Education and International Baccalaureate (IB) programs with local curricula (WASSCE, BECE). The school emphasizes academic excellence, character development, and global citizenship through residential campus life and specialized programs including STEM, sports, and career counseling.

## Key Topics

- International Baccalaureate (IB)
- Cambridge International Education
- WASSCE (West African Senior School Certificate Examination)
- BECE (Basic Education Certificate Examination)
- STEM Programs
- Academic Excellence
- Student Support Services
- Career Counselling
- Residential Campus
- Global Citizenship
- IBDP (International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme)
- Cambridge IGCSE
- Exam Preparation
- Learning Support

## Academic Programs

- [Programs Overview](https://mics.edu.gh/programs): Academic programs including Cambridge IGCSE, CAIE, and IBDP curriculum pathways
- [International Baccalaureate Program](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/international-baccalaureate): IB program details: Theory of Knowledge, Extended Essay, CAS portfolio, global citizenship
- [Cambridge Program](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/camrbidge-program): Cambridge International Program: Primary, Lower Secondary, IGCSE preparation
- [WASSCE Program](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/wassce): WASSCE exam preparation, ghanaian curriculum, and university entry coaching
- [BECE Program](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/bece): BECE program details, exam preparation, and senior high school transition support

## Specialized Programs

- [STEM Program](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/stem): STEM program with robotics, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, AI, and engineering challenges
- [Sports Program](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/sport): Sports program, athletics, ISSAG Games competition, and character development

## Student Support & Development

- [Learning Support](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/learning-support): Learning support services, academic accommodations, and study strategies for students
- [Career Counselling](https://mics.edu.gh/rt-program/career-counselling): Career guidance, university applications, aptitude assessment, and interview skills
